claims.text: The positive review share dropped to 62.69% overall in the window from 2025-09-16 to 2025-09-29.
The baseline positive review share was 73.66% from 2025-08-19 to 2025-09-15.
Negative reviews mentioning performance rose by 5.31 points in the window compared to the baseline.
Negative reviews mentioning platform policy rose by 5.25 points in the window.
Negative reviews mentioning stability and bugs rose by 3.38 points in the window.
There was 1 sale day recorded during the evaluation window.
There were 0 discount days recorded during the window.
Negative reviews flagged as off-topic dropped by 0.12 percentage points in the window.
Positive reviews flagged as off-topic increased by 0.11 percentage points.
New players share among total reviews was 0.69% during the window.
New players share among baseline reviews was 0.89%.
Total reviews in the window reached 6797 compared to 17800 in the baseline period.
The compositional effect on review sentiment change was calculated at -1.49 percentage points.

findings.title: Player tenure and reviewer mix changes

report.summary: The positive review share fell to 62.69% in the window from 2025-09-16 to 2025-09-29 compared to the baseline positive review share of 73.66% from 2025-08-19 to 2025-09-15. Negative reviews mentioning performance rose by 5.31 pp, negative reviews mentioning platform policy rose by 5.25 pp, and negative reviews mentioning stability and bugs rose by 3.38 pp in the window. Total reviews reached 6797 compared to 17800 in the baseline period. A review bomb and noise are ruled out. The patch, a price change or sale, and a change in who reviewed are inconclusive.
